skill_advice.Docker: Frequently required for containerized microservices and standardizing deployment environments. Consider building and containerizing a multi-tier project with Docker Compose.
skill_advice.AWS: High-priority cloud platform in enterprise hiring. Recommended to highlight hands-on experience with S3, EC2, Lambda, or get familiar with AWS Free Tier.
skill_advice.Kubernetes: Valuable for orchestrating distributed systems at scale. Consider trying minikube or containerizing a sample application with Kubernetes manifests.
skill_advice.CI/CD: Modern engineering teams expect automated testing and deployment. Add a simple GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) to your projects.
skill_advice.TypeScript: Rapidly becoming standard for frontend and full-stack roles due to type safety. Refactoring an existing JavaScript project to TypeScript is a great portfolio item.
skill_advice.REST API: The foundational communication layer between web clients and backends. Make sure your project descriptions highlight CRUD endpoints, authentication, and HTTP status codes.
skill_advice.PostgreSQL: The industry standard relational database for high-integrity transactional apps. Highlight schema design, indexing, or relational querying in your resume.
skill_advice.Redis: Frequently used for caching, rate limiting, and pub/sub. Adding Redis caching to a backend project boosts engineering credibility.
skill_advice.GraphQL: Alternative to REST favored for complex multi-resource client queries. Consider learning Apollo Client/Server to stand out.

Docker.desc: Understand images, containers, and Dockerfile commands (FROM, RUN, CMD)
Connect a web app (Flask/Node) with a database (PostgreSQL/Redis) using docker-compose.yml
Learn multi-stage builds and minimal base images (alpine/distroless)

AWS.desc: Set up S3 static storage, EC2 Linux instance, and IAM security permissions
Build an AWS Lambda function triggered by API Gateway
Deploy a containerized application to AWS ECS or Elastic Beanstalk

Kubernetes.desc: Learn Pods, Deployments, Services, and Namespaces using Minikube or Kind
Manage ConfigMaps, Secrets, and Persistent Volumes
Package applications with Helm charts and expose via Ingress controller

CI/CD.desc: Create a GitHub Actions workflow that runs linter and unit tests on pull request
Automate Docker image creation and pushing to Docker Hub or GitHub Container Registry
Deploy automatically to a cloud host on main branch merge

TypeScript.desc: Primitive types, Interfaces, Type Aliases, and Union types
Master Pick, Omit, Partial, and generic functions/classes
Build a React + Node project with shared TypeScript schemas

REST API.desc: Status codes, idempotent methods (GET, PUT, DELETE, POST), URL conventions
JWT token authentication, input validation, and secure password hashing
Document with OpenAPI/Swagger and write comprehensive integration tests
